notes.content: This journal collects decisions for the capstone so they do not disappear across chat threads. The project studies how bilingual students search personal archives when they remember meaning but not exact wording. A dry run with two friends is scheduled before formal collection so confusing prompts can be removed. The supervised pilot review is booked for November 12 at 2 PM in Lab 3B; Professor Allen wants the recruitment script, consent screen, and deletion procedure available during the review. Analysis will separate exact, natural-language, and mixed queries, while cross-language searches will be reported as an architecture boundary rather than blended into the release gate. The presentation should include one failed search trace from every source type and explain whether extraction, chunking, embedding, or fusion caused it. A second reviewer will audit ten labels without seeing the ranking. All participant exports must be deleted after aggregate numbers are checked. notes.content: Welcome back. Today we are connecting evaluation design with product decisions. A model score is useful only when the dataset represents the users and failure modes the team claims to serve. Start by writing down the unit of judgment: a response, a retrieved document, or a completed user task. Then separate offline metrics from evidence collected in a live workflow. If annotators can see model rankings, their labels may drift toward the system, so relevance should be recorded before comparing configurations. For multilingual products, do not average supported and unsupported language pairs into a single release number. Report the boundary directly and decide whether the product will add a multilingual model, maintain separate indexes, or narrow its promise. The red-team workshop moved to October 22 at 11 AM in Engineering 204; bring one prompt-injection example and one retrieval false positive from your project. During the workshop, teams will exchange datasets and attempt to find hidden shortcuts such as duplicated questions, source-language confounds, or answers always appearing at the start of a document. Afterward, freeze the reviewed cases and keep failures even when they make the score look worse. Latency measurements must name the hardware and build type because simulator results do not establish phone performance. Your final presentation should show one decision that changed because of evidence, not just a dashboard of metrics. Include consent and deletion behavior whenever cloud processing is involved. notes.title: Practical guide to retrieval evaluation
notes.middleMarker: Freeze relevance labels before running configuration comparisons
notes.endMarker: Archive the signed evaluation report on December 8
notes.content: A useful retrieval evaluation starts with a concrete user task, not a model leaderboard. Collect queries in the language people naturally use and ask annotators which notes would genuinely help complete the task. Include exact wording, paraphrases, mixed-language phrases, and queries with no relevant result. Record source type and language separately so an apparent OCR problem cannot secretly be an English-model problem. Keep distractors that share topics, dates, or entities with targets. Long documents should place evidence away from the opening paragraph and should be tested at more than one position. Before measuring, document retrieval mode, embedding version, chunk strategy, top K, corpus hash, hardware, and build type. Freeze relevance labels before running configuration comparisons; reviewers must not rewrite expected answers after seeing which system wins. Report in-scope and cross-language cases separately whenever production does not support both in one vector space. Recall at five shows whether all required notes appear near the top, while reciprocal rank reveals how early the first useful note appears. Negative cases need their own no-result accuracy because adding them to Recall would make the denominator meaningless. Treat an empty result as correct only when the expectation explicitly says no relevant result. Latency percentiles must come from release builds, and phone claims require phone measurements. Preserve failures as regression cases after a reviewer assigns a cause. Do not add a negative threshold to the release gate until behavior is stable across multiple runs. End the report with limitations, consent status, and unresolved architecture choices. Archive the signed evaluation report on December 8 together with the frozen dataset version and reviewer notes.
